The rider's own device track places the rider roughly 725 to 732 metres from the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for this STANDARD zone class, so the rider was not at the pickup point.

ledger.claim: The GPS trace is COMPLETE with 100 percent coverage, no gaps, and a 10 second sample interval, so the arrival and dwell findings rest on clean evidence at full weight and no POL-NS-08 impairment applies.

The rider's claim that they 'never saw the car' is contradicted by the driver's trace showing the vehicle stationary at the pin for 400 seconds and by the driver's chat message at 15:11:54, which the rider read at 15:12:24 — the rider had notice of the driver's presence and did not appear.

The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 400 seconds, from 15:11:34 to 15:18:14, with 41 qualifying fixes — comfortably past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the driver's own evidence.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 15:11:34, matching the first qualifying in-geofence fix to the second, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 15:18:15 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are both satisfied.

The arrival marker is not false. The driver's trace shows a distinct speed of 0.0 kph at the arrival moment and the qualifying run begins exactly at the 'arrived' timestamp, so the driver was stationary inside the geofence rather than travelling at or above 15 kph or more than 300 m away. POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee.
The dwell is not short. The measured in-geofence run is 400 seconds against a 180 second minimum, a surplus of 220 seconds, so POL-NS-06's waiting-period shortfall route is unavailable to the rider.

The driver did not merely hold position silently: he sent an in-app message at 15:11:54, twenty seconds after arriving, stating 'im at the pickup point'. The message was delivered and read by the rider at 15:12:24, and the rider never replied. The driver's counterparty statement that he was at the pin for over six minutes is corroborated by the trace.

The rider's own device track places the rider roughly 725 to 732 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider presence radius. The rider was not at the pickup point, which is consistent with the driver's account and inconsistent with the rider's claim that he was waiting and never saw the car.

The rider's claim that he 'never saw the car' is not a locating or coordinating message and does not engage POL-NS-04: the chat log holds exactly one message, sent by the driver, and no rider message at all. Limb (a) of POL-NS-04 fails on the record, so the rider is not exonerated by that clause.

The charge is correctly recorded. The fare breakdown shows a cancellation fee of SGD 4.50, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 for this trip, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.

The driver is entitled to compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, that is SGD 3.60, under POL-NS-07, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 126 completed trips in 30 days is far below 0.08. Both limbs of the check must hold and neither does.

The missing traffic advisory does not help the rider. There is only one interval here in any event, and the single 400 second run already exceeds the minimum, so the absence of an advisory is immaterial to the outcome.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this was a verified driver no-show. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands, and the driver is owed SGD 3.60 as his payout under POL-NS-07 (80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force for this trip, EV-FARE-02721). No refund is due to the rider.

POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four are on the record. (a) EV-TRIP-02721 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 15:11:34. (b) EV-GPS-02721 puts him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — his closest approach to the pin was 0.0 m — with 41 qualifying fixes, far past the 3-fix test of POL-NS-02. (c) He held position there continuously for 400 seconds, 15:11:34 to 15:18:14, against the 180-second free waiting period in force, more than double. (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 15:18:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event.

Your account, rider, does not hold up on your own evidence. The rider track inside the same GPS trace places your device about 725 to 732 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with no qualifying fix inside the 100 m rider-presence radius — you were not at the pickup point. You also sent no message: EV-CHAT-02721 holds exactly one message, the driver's 'im at the pickup point' at 15:11:54, which you read at 15:12:24 and never answered. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you because its limb (a) requires a rider message and there is none.

I checked every clause that could displace the fee. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival timestamp the driver's distance was 0.0 m and his speed 0.0 kph, so the marker is genuine and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 does not fire: 400 seconds against 180 seconds is a surplus, not a shortfall. POL-NS-03 does not apply, as the driver was inside the arrival radius and not at a wrong entrance. POL-NS-10 does not apply, as the rider did not cancel. The driver's own account that he was at the pin for over six minutes is consistent with, but adds nothing to, the trace.

Nothing escalates. The trace is complete (100% coverage, 10 s cadence, no gaps), so POL-NS-08 finds no integrity defect and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged; the profiles show zero same-pair disputes and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1 of 126 completed trips in 30 days is far below 0.08, both limbs being required. The only profile figures this ruling touches are driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d, which are the figures POL-NS-07 names; no context-only profile field was used as a ground.

Two claims were discarded at the citation stage for citing the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02721-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0) without naming its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the advisory's absence changes nothing here, because the driver's single continuous in-geofence run already exceeds the minimum without any accumulation. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the execution threshold, so it executes automatically, and either party may appeal within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
